# The appointments Tagaloa made — and who is keeping them

The mistake is reading myths as entertainment. Tagaloa's cycle reads more like a charter — each story assigning a duty the modern world still pays for.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Tagaloa
- **Pantheon:** Polynesian
- **Domain of influence:** Creator, Ocean
- **Pattern seats:** 3
- **Sectors touched:** Energy & Natural World · Culture & Entertainment
- **Strongest seat:** Maritime, Shipping & Ocean Industries
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 468 of 546

## The Cycle, Read Forward

### Maritime, Shipping & Ocean Industries — through *The Vine Let Down into the Sea*

In the beginning Tagaloa dwelt alone in Lani-uli, the highest heaven, and beneath him lay only the boundless sea.  He let down into the waters a vine from the sky; where its parts touched the surface, the islands of Samoa rose.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *Primary seat: Tagaloa embodies creator, ocean — the core of maritime.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. The trade thinks it is optimizing a process. It is re-enacting a charter.

### Travel, Tourism & Place Branding — through *Sina and the Eel*

Tagaloa's daughter Sina came down to the pool of Mata o le Alelo to bathe, where a great eel, Tuna, confessed its love.  When the eel was killed at Sina's command, she buried its head, and from it grew the first coconut palm — its two eyes, mouth, and body still showing on the nut.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *Resonant seat: Tagaloa shares symbolic territory with travel tourism.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. The trade thinks it is optimizing a process. It is re-enacting a charter.

### Freshwater & Hydrology — through *The Storeys of the Sky*

Samoan cosmology stacks the sky into storeys — Lani-uli, Lani-ʻula, and the heavens beneath them — and places Tagaloa at the summit, above the winds that carry rain.  Krämer (The Samoa Islands, 1902) recorded prayers addressing the ascending heavens by name, each storey ruled or traversed on the way to the Lord's seat.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *Resonant seat: Tagaloa shares symbolic territory with water utilities.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. The trade thinks it is optimizing a process. It is re-enacting a charter.

## The Theme That Runs the Cycle

Tagaloa's mythology is cosmogony in the strict sense — stories of how land, people, and rank came to be. It survives not in epic but in creation chants recorded by nineteenth-century missionaries and ethnographers, whose accounts disagree in detail but agree that the world began when the Lord of the Heavens acted upon the sea.

## The Method, Stated Plainly

Skeptical? Good — the system is built for you. Every seat in this file carries its why-line and its weight, the full derivation is public at the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/), and the challenge process is part of the design. Falsifiable is not a posture here; it is the mechanism.

## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in maritime, shipping & ocean industries, travel, tourism & place branding, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/tagaloa/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit.
